name: searcherries
description: All your GEO and SEO data for AI agents in one read-only connection: AI visibility, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4, plus a skill that turns the findings into page changes.

interface.longDescription:
Searcherries gives your AI agent all the data it needs for GEO and SEO in one connection: how AI assistants answer your customers' questions about your market, plus your Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4 data.

Connect Searcherries once and ask in plain language. The agent can build a prioritized action plan, find the questions where AI answers leave your brand out and see which competitors and sources they rely on instead, spot the pages and search queries with the most growth potential, and check how much traffic AI assistants send to your site and where it lands. When the agent can work with your website's code, the included skill turns these findings into concrete page changes and edits the files once you approve them.

Built for founders, marketers and SEO specialists who want their site recommended in AI answers and found in search.

Limitations: you need a Searcherries account with at least one project. Search Console and GA4 data are available on every Searcherries plan and appear only for the sources you connect; AI visibility tracking (AI answers, competitors, citations) and Bing Webmaster Tools require a paid plan. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot change projects, questions or settings, and it returns the results of Searcherries' scheduled checks rather than running new ones. It only sees the projects of the account you authorize.
capabilities: Build a prioritized GEO and SEO action plan
Read stored AI answers and their judgments
Read competitors and sources named in AI answers
Read Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools data
Read GA4 traffic from AI assistants
Propose page changes based on the data
defaultPrompt: What should I work on next to get my brand recommended by AI assistants?
Which customer questions do AI answers leave my brand out of, and who do they name instead?
Give me recommendations for the pages and search queries with the most growth potential.

positive.description: List the projects of the signed-in account
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the projects of the test account with their status, tracked AI platforms and connected data sources. No projects from other accounts appear.

positive.description: Prioritized next steps for a project
positive.prompt: What should I work on next for my Searcherries project?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to five prioritized actions for the project, each with dated evidence from the stored data and a link to the Searcherries report. When evidence is missing, it says which data is missing instead of guessing.

positive.description: Summarize AI visibility for the last 30 days
positive.prompt: Summarize the AI visibility of my Searcherries project for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the visibility score, mentions by AI platform, the change against the previous period, share of voice and the top competitors and cited domains, with the dates of the period.

positive.description: Find AI answers that leave the brand out
positive.prompt: Which customer questions do AI assistants answer without naming my brand, and which competitors do they name instead?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tracked questions whose stored answers do not name the brand or name it only in passing, by platform and check date, and the competitor brands those answers name.

positive.description: Show the sources AI answers cite
positive.prompt: Which sources do AI assistants cite when they answer my tracked questions?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the URLs and domains cited in the stored answers to the tracked questions for the period, with citation counts and platforms, and marks any URLs from the project's own website.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported. The plugin is read-only and should say it cannot delete projects, pointing the user to the Searcherries app.
negative.prompt: Delete my Searcherries project and all of its data.

negative.description: Running checks or editing tracked questions is not supported. The plugin should explain that it reads stored results only and that questions are changed in the Searcherries app.
negative.prompt: Run a new AI visibility check right now and add "best CRM for startups" as a tracked question.

negative.description: Projects of other accounts are not accessible. The plugin should say the project is not in the authorized account rather than guess or show data.
negative.prompt: Show me the AI visibility report of hubspot.com from another Searcherries customer's account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads data from an existing Searcherries account.

publication.release_notes: The listing name is now Searcherries: AI SEO, and the limitations say which data needs a paid Searcherries plan. Tools, skill and data access are unchanged.
